title: Management meetings center shows persona review panels with title, conclusion and positions

runtime_budget.notes: Pure frontend rendering, localization, and BFF payload normalization; adds no recurring job, emitter, or persistent writer.

acceptance_coverage.AC1: MeetingsCenterPage includes persona review panels (session_class 'gate_panel') in history and in the type filter bar ([data-testid='meetings-type-filter-gate_panel'] next to MT-1..MT-6 and All). Each gate panel row renders a localized zh-TW title naming the subject persona and reviewed strategy pool version (with retry suffix when present, e.g. '青禾 · 策略池第 6 版發布風控審查（第 2 次重試）'), formatted date and time (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm), and conclusion in words listing each reviewer's recommendation and whether an operator decision is needed (e.g. '主審（研究與決策長）：建議補充研究；風控審查（風控長）：建議補充研究 · 需操作者決定'). Missing display names fall back to localized role labels paired with a short id suffix so a raw consult-envelope-publication id or persona id is never the only name.
acceptance_coverage.AC2: MeetingDetailPage renders gate panel details with header conclusion ([data-testid='meeting-detail-gate-conclusion']), reviewer cards with role, recommendation badge, and cited claims ([data-testid='meeting-detail-reviewers']), memo summary and recommendation ([data-testid='meeting-detail-memo'], [data-testid='meeting-memo-id'], [data-testid='meeting-memo-summary']), and the open-by-default case-file view ([data-testid='meeting-detail-case-file-view'] -> CaseFileViewPanel). stripPrivateMemory in src/lib/bff-v1/meetings.ts strips any private/withheld items and their cited_item_ids from case_file_view before rendering so private text withheld by the BFF never leaks.
acceptance_coverage.AC3: npm run lint reports 0 errors (0 errors, 136 pre-existing warnings); tsc --noEmit passes with 0 errors; locale parity test (i18nParity.test.ts) passes 17/17; meetings unit tests (meetings.test.tsx, meetings.test.ts, enumLabels.test.ts, MeetingActionCards.test.tsx) cover gate panel list rows, type filter, detail reviewers/memo/case-file, and private-item withholding with 94/94 passing tests and no existing test weakened or deleted.
acceptance_coverage.AC4: Ready for review by Claude2 (independent model family from owner Antigravity) and post-merge hosted dev verification as admintest on https://app.dev.mvl-cap.tw/management/meetings.
